description: Claim a received message for processing — record that this agent is working on it now, so a restarted agent can tell what it already handled. Returns the message's state (`processing`). Fails with `message_already_claimed` when another credential of the same account holds a live claim; an expired claim does not block. Follow it with `complete_message`.

claimedBy.description: Optional: a label for which worker of yours holds the claim, e.g. `worker-1`. Defaults to the credential.

domainId.description: The id of the domain that received the message — from `list_domains`. Required: the state belongs to one domain's mailbox.

messageId.description: The message id — the `messageId` value from a `list_events` row (the SMTP Message-ID).

name: claim_message
